description: This Java servlet class handles SEO-friendly URL parsing and generation for product and category pages in an e-commerce application, specifically within the OFBiz framework. It processes URL path info to identify product and category IDs, sets request attributes, and forwards to appropriate views. It also provides static methods to construct such URLs based on category and product IDs.

classes.name: SeoCatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: A servlet that manages SEO-friendly URLs for product and category pages, parsing URL paths to identify products and categories, and generating URLs based on category and product IDs.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates POST requests to the doGet method for URL processing.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes incoming GET requests, extracts product and category IDs from URL path info, sets request attributes, and forwards to the appropriate view.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a product or category page based on request context, current and previous category IDs.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a product or category page based on provided context path, breadcrumb trail, and category/product IDs.
